_comment: Which InsightfulPipe skills go in which Claude plugin. A skill joins a plugin when its slug is in that plugin's include list, or its category is in the plugin's categories and its slug is not in that plugin's exclude list or another plugin's include list. Every skill belongs to at most one plugin; scripts/sync_plugin.py stops if two plugins claim the same skill. Skills no plugin claims stay in the full Insightful-Pipe/marketing-skills bundle.
